# Main

`jmfsb_main`

The mod's root: version, macros, author and the shared script_mod header
every other addon includes. Nothing here does anything at runtime; everything
here is what lets the rest compile.

The Eden toolbar's Wiki item opens the unit's GitHub page, the same link as
`mod.cpp` and `jmfsb_fa_main` (review L4: a find-and-replace had put the unit's
name inside the URL).
